latest.title: After-close report, Fri 20 Nov
latest.text:
**Market:** The ASX 200 fell 1.6% to 8,593, its seventh loss in a row. Tech led the drop and miners and healthcare fell again. Echoiq rose 20%, and Koala jumped 12.7%, which was also this morning's sealed pick.

**SVL and silver:** silver fell another 5.9% to US$41.74 and gold fell 3.8% to US$3,545, both at fresh lows. SVL had no news and no big move in the laptop feed. Bitcoin is US$61.9k (-2.4%) and Ethereum US$1,742 (-3.2%).

**Paper trades** (to last night's close): BUY trades average **-21%** closed and **-12%** open after costs. That's still too few to judge, and tonight's run updates it.

**Today:** the morning pick was sealed (KOA). The backup caught up at 11:31 AM after the Passport went back in. Tonight's cloud research does the 2025-26 check on the smaller-shares recipe.

**To fix:** the set api key step is still open (zac or Ryan). Until it's done, no morning reads are scored by Claude.

reports.title: Pre-market report, Fri 20 Nov
reports.text:
**Market setup:** It's another tough morning for miners. Overnight silver fell 4.9% to US$42.84 and gold fell 3% to US$3,628, so gold and silver stocks look weak after six straight down days for the ASX 200 (8,730 at yesterday's close). The Aussie dollar slipped to 66.6c. Bitcoin is US$62.1k and Ethereum US$1,757. News to watch: NextDC upgraded its FY27 guidance, Pro Medicus signed a A$128m NYC hospitals deal, Turners posted a record half, and there are halts at MPW and RCR. There's nothing new from SVL, but silver's fresh drop is a headwind.

**Paper trades** (to yesterday's close): BUY trades average **-21%** closed and **-12%** open after costs, and WATCH trades **-33%** closed and **-5%** open. That's still too few to judge. Today's pick has no strong buy, so STW stays the default. BHP, CBA and NAB are small speculative stakes only.

**Overnight research:** the best new recipe (smaller All Ords shares outside the top 300, 20 most-traded and furthest above their 50-day average, held 13 weeks) made **22.2% a year vs STW's 7.8%** on 2015-21, with a **+6.4%** average trade after costs. It's not checked on 2025-26 prices yet, and that check is next. The cheaper turnover-rank shortcut doesn't work. So far there have been 525,606 tries in total.

**To fix:** nothing urgent. The evening run finished cleanly. Plug the Passport back in when you can (zac), since the last backup was 3:07 PM yesterday.

**SVL and silver:** silver steadied at US$45.42 (+0.8%) after its fall, and gold was flat. SVL had no news and no big move in the laptop feed. Bitcoin is US$63.4k (-1.9%) and Ethereum US$1,800 (-0.6%).

**Paper trades:** there's still no fresh profit %. Last night's paper report came out empty, so tonight's run (from 6:15 PM) should refresh it.

reports.title: After-close report, Wed 18 Nov
reports.text:
**Market:** The ASX 200 fell 0.7% to 8,822. Wall Street dropped overnight on Nvidia worries, and metals slid. Lendlease fell about 15% after a Morgan Stanley Sell call. Nuix jumped 45% on a takeover deal with Haveli, and Gorilla Gold rose 45% on a WA gold deal.

**SVL and silver:** SVL rose 7.7% to 14c even though silver fell 3% to US$45.95, close to a one-year low. Gold fell 2%. Bitcoin is about flat at US$64.6k and Ethereum is down 1% at US$1,811.

**Paper trades** (to last night's close): closed trades average **-27%** after costs and open trades **-9%**. That's still too few trades to judge.

**Today:** new code went live at 10:44 and passed its tests. The morning picks were sealed (KOA, plus BRE from Claude). The backup worked again on the new Passport. The Risk Ladder research still hasn't started.

**To fix:** nothing urgent.
